Paragraph: "If Seetha were here to bathe in these clear waters, her laughter would double the beauty of this place..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: Imagining Seetha enjoying the natural environment brings both sweetness and acute pain.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Rama visualizes Seetha's joyful presence in the present setting.
Outcome/Resolution: Mental imagery provides temporary sweetness but reinforces current absence.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Smarana-Ananda (Sweetness found in loving recollection mixed with pain of loss)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Visualizing the divine consort in nature highlights how her presence elevates all of creation to absolute joy.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Wishful mental simulation: imagining a loved one's presence to fulfill emotional needs while highlighting current absence.
